proposedEntry.name: critique-information-density
proposedEntry.description: Makes the agent critique a rendered screen's information density along four dimensions - cognitive load, content priority, scanning pattern (F/Z-pattern fit, label alignment, chunking), and progressive disclosure - each with pointed evaluation questions; enforces an output format of observation / problem / fix per dimension with a pass / minor issue / major issue rating; and names common failure patterns (every-metric dashboards, 10+ column tables, front-loaded onboarding).
